retrievalProfile.description: A soft-focus group portrait of four men with feathered hair and velvet attire, featuring a large-scale serif header overlapping the top edge.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight triangular composition of four male figures with 1970s-style feathered and shag haircuts, dressed in textured fabrics like velvet and corduroy, set against a neutral, softly lit studio background with a prominent peach-toned serif title at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Triangular grouping of subjects creating a dense central focus
Soft-focus lighting contrasting with sharp, high-contrast typography
Muted, desaturated background tones emphasizing the warm skin tones and peach text
Textual overlap where the header sits closely above the subjects' heads
coreInvariants: Soft, diffused studio lighting with a slight vignette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged in a pyramid formation, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face and the large-scale header text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large header, moves down through the central faces, and follows the diagonal lines of the subjects' shoulders.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily located in the upper corners around the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted greys and off-whites in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and browns of the hair and velvet jackets.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft peach or salmon pink for the primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark clothing and pale skin/background.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes

composition.overlap: Close to or slightly touching hair

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large display serif paired with a tiny, centered sans-serif or serif at the bottom for secondary info.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and elegant 70s editorial look.
Provides the necessary weight and sharp serifs.
Captures the specific 70s tight-kerning display aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus studio portrait of four men with 70s shag haircuts in velvet blazers, arranged in a pyramid, against a desaturated grey background with a slight vignette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, centered title at the top in a bold, high-contrast peach-colored Didone serif font with tight letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the hair feathered and voluminous?
Is the lighting soft with a vintage film grain?
Is the top text a high-contrast serif?
Is the color palette muted with a peach accent?

adjustableVariables: Specific color of the header text
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific faces of the original band members
Do not use the exact band name or album title
Do not copy the specific logo if one exists
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible but tightly spaced
Check that the hair textures look soft and layered
Verify the triangular composition of the group
Confirm the background is desaturated and non-distracting
